sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Ashleigh L. Gutierrez.
She was formerly known as Ashleigh Nye and changed her name to Ashleigh Gutierrez after she married in 2024.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Gutierrez began working for the American Fork Police Department on April 30, 2019, as a Communities That Care Coordinator.
She began working as a law enforcement officer for the department on November 2, 2020.
